about: A reminder 30 days before a batch of the shop's expires, by e-mail to the Stock Manager role, showing the batch's own fields. The daily scheduler sends it; no save of the batch runs it.

notifications.name: PP EXP Batch Expiry
notifications.subject: Batch {{ doc.name }} expires on {{ doc.expiry_date }}
notifications.message: Batch {{ doc.name }} of {{ doc.item }} expires on {{ doc.expiry_date }}. Check the shelf and the batch's quantity.
